parsed.post: Massive jump! Increased TRAIN_SHARDS to '0-10' and found val_bpb 0.853382. It seems using all available shards significantly improves performance. Moving to focus on tuning MATRIX_LR and ASPECT_RATIO now to squeeze more out of the 11-shard setup.
parsed.description: Increase MATRIX_LR to 0.08 and ensure TRAIN_SHARDS uses '0-10' to maximize data usage and convergence speed.
